amendment: Clarify context scope, pin corrected probe and runtime inputs, and add a loopback proxy that restricts model tool calls before dispatch.

interpretation.restriction: An 8K live screen cannot establish 1M-context quality, KV footprint, or production safety; it only screens LlamaAgentBackend fan-out mechanics at 8K. The 1M assertion is unit-only and no production profile is changed.

correctedImplementation.fixtureFileClose: Close both marker fixtures explicitly after writes; QFile::close returns void and cannot participate in a boolean chain.
correctedImplementation.gitWorktreeList: Include QProcess for observing cleanup after the backend has completed.
correctedImplementation.toolGuard: Proxy exposes task only to the parent and read_file only to subagents. It buffers each upstream SSE response and rejects unexpected tool names before forwarding any result to LlamaCode.
correctedImplementation.temporaryWorkspace: Supervisor sets TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP to the Q100 task-local disposable directory so Git worktrees cannot collide with other /tmp worktrees.
